checks.scope: Provenance and uniqueness of referenced values or completed actions.
checks.observable: Name a supplied contract/local producer and distinguish multiple candidates.
checks.consistency: A technique guarantee by name can conflict with AP-157 delivery requirements.
checks.exceptions: Anchored local references and checkable evidence are sound; a supplier name alone is not.
checks.fix: Declare and bind the value/precondition rather than linking an unavailable producer.
checks.expression: Name the supplier should not imply naming is sufficient.

entries.rationale: The provenance test needs evidence delivery as well as an address.

checks.scope: Bootstrap text before session-backed lookup exists.
checks.observable: Remove references and test whether every instruction still has executable substance.
checks.consistency: DP-33 explicitly permits necessary inline substance at this boundary.
checks.exceptions: Direct resource URIs and forward labels have actionable versus descriptive roles.
checks.fix: Inline the required substance and mark future-home labels as nonessential now.
checks.expression: The temporal scope and strike-reference test are concrete.

entries.rationale: AP-122 deletion applies only when citation preserves fidelity; an unresolved pre-session cite cannot meet that premise.

checks.scope: Instruction audience and duty reach, with orientation needing a separate boundary.
checks.observable: Check whether the reader can act on or verify the described fact.
checks.consistency: Third-person duty rewriting can compete with DP-17 orientation voice.
checks.exceptions: Checkable preconditions and role data are protected; add descriptive orientation.
checks.fix: Address actual duties to the reader while preserving legitimate descriptions.
checks.expression: The surface list is broader than the word instruction suggests.

entries.rationale: Narrow normative duty detection instead of treating all third-person behavior as instruction.

checks.scope: Technique-local rules attempting to own wider subject policy.
checks.observable: Compare constrained subject, produced product, and delivered audience.
checks.consistency: The exceptions distinguish local conformance from wider ownership.
checks.exceptions: Own outputs/cadence and canonical pointers remain valid.
checks.fix: Move wider policy to its owner and retain the technique-specific obligation.
checks.expression: The subject/reader tests are concrete qualitative checks.

entries.rationale: Broad policy scope is measurable by who is bound and whether they receive the rule.

checks.scope: Leaf Inputs repeated from merged ancestor contracts.
checks.observable: Resolve the effective contract and compare duplicate or changed slots.
checks.consistency: Unrestricted optionality changes can violate DP-46 substitutability.
checks.exceptions: Contract-changing exemptions need an accepted-input/guarantee test.
checks.fix: Remove duplicates; represent stricter needs through a distinct contract or conforming wrapper.
checks.expression: Optionality the technique needs is not a sufficient safety condition.

entries.rationale: A required leaf input can reject a call the advertised ancestor permits.

checks.scope: Prose repeating facts already readable from schema.
checks.observable: Compare the semantic claim to the schema-owned field.
checks.consistency: The schema-extension Fix exceeds Detect and AP-02 scope.
checks.exceptions: Engine-only facts the schema cannot carry are correctly exempt.
checks.fix: Delete/cite owned facts; separately scope new schema capability.
checks.expression: Cannot express then declare it in schema is unclear and potentially unexecutable.

entries.rationale: Remove the repair branch that does not follow from the detector.

checks.scope: Engine internals disclosed to a caller with only tool-level reach.
checks.observable: Deletion should leave calls, arguments, and recognizable outcomes unchanged.
checks.consistency: Actionable constraints remain under DP-17 and tool-contract principles.
checks.exceptions: Paths to write, failure recognition, and behavior invariants are protected.
checks.fix: Keep the obligation and tool interaction while removing irrelevant machinery.
checks.expression: The changed-action test disambiguates useful detail from narration.

entries.rationale: This is an observable relevance rule rather than a blanket ban on technical explanation.

checks.scope: Fixed admitted values of declared variables in prose only.
checks.observable: Compare enumerated prose with the variable values declaration.
checks.consistency: Structured enum ownership complements AP-126 and AP-149.
checks.exceptions: Computed sets and non-string forms the schema cannot carry are excepted.
checks.fix: Declare the supported set once and leave meaning/absence in prose.
checks.expression: The added-option thought experiment exposes the drift risk.

entries.rationale: A structural source-of-truth test is possible without testing every enum member dynamically.
